paragraphs: Rav. Rav Aha bar Rav; Rav Yitzhak bar Rav; Ulla bar Rav; Rami bar Rav. [Glosses: Rav. (1) Shevuot 49a: ‘R' Giddel said that Rava said.’ It should read Rav, as it does in שס״ח [edition unidentified]. (2) Bava Batra 155b: Giddel bar Menashya sent to Rava, ‘Let our teacher instruct us.’ Yuhasin writes, ‘Perhaps this is another man’; that is, since we find in Mo'ed Katan 24b that he spoke in Rav's name, and in Shmuel's name there, a, how could he send to Rava, who was born the day Rav Yehudah, Rav's pupil, died? In my view it should read ‘sent to Rav,’ and so I saw there in Rashbam. Yet in Rosh and Rif, ‘to Rava’ occurs several times, and it was not corrected [ל״ת, provisionally ‘not corrected’, here and below]. (3) Beitzah 7, end of a: Rav Gamda in Rav's name. It seems to me it should read ‘in Rava's name’; it was not corrected. We find him speaking in Rava's name many times; see his entry. This Gemara misled the author of She'erit Yosef, who counted him among Rav's pupils. (4) Shabbat 142a: ‘R' Hiyya bar Ashi said that Rava said.’ It seems to me it should read ‘Rav said.’ (5) Yevamot 25b: ‘But Rav said that R' Hiyya bar Avin said that R' Amram said.’ It seems to me that the word Rav is superfluous; it was not corrected. One cannot say it should read ‘But Rava said that R' Hiyya bar Avin said,’ for Responsa Bah writes that R' Hiyya bar Avin was Rava's pupil; see what I wrote about this in the Rules. (6) Kiddushin 71, end of a: Huna bar Tahlifa in Rav's name. This caused the error by which the author of She'erit Yosef placed him among Rav's pupils. It seems to me it should read ‘in Rava's name,’ for Yevamot 8b, Niddah 26a, Bava Metzia 35a have ‘in Rava's name’; it was not corrected in שס״ח [edition unidentified]. (7) Shevuot 18a: ‘R' Huna said that Rava said.’ It should read Rav; not corrected. (8) Bava Kamma 84a: Rav Zevid in Rav's name. This caused She'erit Yosef to place him among Rav's pupils. It should read ‘in Rava's name’; not corrected. (9) Zevahim 25b: ‘R' Zeira said that Rabbi said.’ It should read Rav; not corrected. So it is also evident in that matter in Bekhorot 39, beginning of b: ‘R' Zeira said that Rav said.’ (10) Rav Hinena bar Yehudah in Rav's name, Sanhedrin 77, end of b. It seems to me it should read Rava; not corrected. (11) Eruvin 5, end of b, 6a: ‘Rav Hanan bar Rava said that Rabbi said.’ It should read Rav, as it does in שס״ח [edition unidentified]. But that matter in Shabbat 9a has ‘R' Hama bar Gurya said that Rav said’; in שס״ח [edition unidentified], ‘Rav Hanan bar Rava said that Rav said.’ (12) Beitzah 31b: Rav Hinena bar Shelemya in Rava's name. It should read ‘in Rav's name,’ as it does in שס״ח [edition unidentified]. (13) Shabbat 101a: R' Tavla asked Ravin. It should read ‘Rav’; not corrected. (14) End of Ba-Meh Ishah: Rav Yeimar bar Shelemya in Rav's name. It should read ‘Rava's.’ (15) Shabbat 39, end of b: ‘R' Yannai said that Rav said.’ It should read ‘Rabbi said’; see there. (16) Pesahim 59b: Rav Safra raised a contradiction to Rav. It should read ‘to Rava’; not corrected. (17) Hagigah 26a: R' Pinhas in Rav's name. See She'erit Yosef, which brings him among Rav's pupils. Perhaps it is a scribal error and should read ‘in Rava's name,’ because in many places he spoke in Rava's name. I labored and found in Rashi, Sanhedrin 85, end of a: ‘As R' Pinhas said at the end of Homer Ba-Kodesh in Rava's name.’ I was pleased. Thus She'erit Yosef erred. The aforementioned Hagigah matter in Yevamot 22b has ‘R' Pinhas in Rav Pappa's name’; this is a scribal error and should read ‘in Rava's name’; not corrected. (18) Avodah Zarah 8b: Rav Pappa in Rav's name. Perhaps it should read ‘Rava's,’ or it is Rav Pappa the Elder, who spoke in Rav's name several times. But in the Amsterdam printing it is ‘in Rava's name,’ as it is in בס״ח [source form; abbreviation unresolved], and I was pleased. (19) Shabbat 140a: Rava bar Sheva. It should read Rav; not corrected. (20) Shabbat 88b: ‘Rav said, “Our affection still remains with us,”’ as it also reads in Ein Yaakov. It should read Rava, as it does in Gittin 36, end of b, and Yalkut, Song of Songs, on ‘We shall make you ornaments of gold.’ (21) Hullin 133, beginning of a: ‘Rav said, “Rav Yosef tested us.”’ It should read Rava, as it does in שס״ח [edition unidentified]. (22) Horayot 12b: ‘Rava said, “Below means literally below.” Shmuel said [otherwise].’ It should read Rav. (23) Niddah 20b: ‘She sent before Rav.’ It should read ‘Rava,’ as it does in שס״ח [edition unidentified].]
